messages:
maria: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing a 'rehearsal + attestation' upgrade playbook for air-gapped on‑prem installs. Goal: let operators validate full activation in a safe sandbox, collect signed attestations from operator and verifier, then promote. Also covers emergency rollback triggers.
kevin: roughly +1. couple questions: how do we isolate rehearsal so it can't affect live traffic?
tara: security concern — need clear signing chain and short-lived attestation tokens. If operator key is compromised rehearsal must not allow promotion.
maria: answers: rehearsal runs on a fenced namespace and uses separate data dirs. no live route changes are applied. promotion is a manual step that requires two attestations: operator and verifier.
maria: proposed workflow (short):
1) upload bundle to airgap staging area
2) run `redwoodctl upgrade --rehearse --bundle <path>` which spins a rehearsal environment
3) run smoke/e2e checks (operator-supplied)
4) collect attestations: `redwoodctl attest --role operator` and `redwoodctl attest --role verifier`
5) `redwoodctl promote --bundle <id> --attestations <operator,verifier>` to flip the activation marker
kevin: can we see the exact CLI flags? maybe include an opt-in `--no-cache-attach` so rehearsal doesn't warm KV caches that would change production metrics.
maria: yep, plan includes `--no-cache-attach`. rough example:```
# create rehearsal (isolated namespaces)
redwoodctl upgrade --rehearse --bundle ./bundle.tar --no-cache-attach --inventory inventory.yaml
# attestations are signed tpm-backed tokens (local HSM optional)
redwoodctl attest --role operator --key /opt/keys/operator.pem --out operator.attest
redwoodctl attest --role verifier --key /opt/keys/verifier.pem --out verifier.attest
# promote (requires both attest files)
redwoodctl promote --bundle ./bundle.tar --attest operator.attest,verifier.attest
```
oliver: operational flags: we need observability hooks — rehearsal run should export traces with a `rehearsal_id` and expose a `dry_promote` endpoint to validate downstream routing without committing. also want a TTL on rehearsal environments to auto-teardown if operator forgets.
maria: agreed. propose `--rehearsal-ttl=24h` default and a `rehearsal_id` shown in logs. logs should contain masked attestation fingerprints.
tara: how do we protect against replay of attestations? verifier attestation must include a nonce from the rehearsal controller. verifier must sign the nonce+bundle-id+timestamp.
maria: exactly — attestation payload: `bundle_id`, `rehearsal_id`, `nonce`, `timestamp`, `attestor_role`. verifier must check nonce freshness against controller.
kevin: one more: rollback. if promote fails or new bundle causes silent regressions, operators should be able to flip a pinned activation marker back to previous bundle without re-running full sync. what's the safety?
maria: design: pinned activation includes activation epoch + immutable object reference. rollback is `redwoodctl rollback --to <bundle-id> --force` but requires a separate rollback attestation from oncall or SRE lead during emergency. also automatic rollback triggers: metric-based (latency spike), health-check failures, or trace-error ratio threshold.
oliver: add an ephemeral safety window: after promote, the system stays in a 'canary hold' for N minutes where traffic shaping routes X% to new bundle and monitors can trigger auto-rollback. we should surface that in console and API.
maria: noted. default canary hold 15m with 10% traffic, configurable.
tara: encryption/signing: attestations stored in the staging area encrypted with KMS; keys in HSM recommended. also audit log must contain attestation hashes, operator id, and rehearsal_id.
maria: yep, retention policy proposal: retain attestations + logs for 90 days by default, exportable to S3 (airgapped: local archive path).
kevin: compatibility: older orchestrators may not support rehearsal namespace. we should provide a fallback: `rehearsal-mode` in the manifest that uses VM-based isolation (quick spin) or skip rehearsal with an explicit `--skip-rehearsal` that requires a higher-level approval.
maria: fallback exists but flagged in console and requires `--approval-level=org-admin`.
ops-bot: Rehearsal smoke job for bundle abc123 completed: 7 checks passed, 2 flaky tests. Artifacts at /var/artifacts/abc123.
oliver: can ops-bot expose the artifact link and attach the attestation fingerprint automatically? that would make audits easier.
maria: plan: ops-bot will emit messages containing attestation SHA256 and rehearsal_id. sample message format: `ops-bot: rehearsal <id> DONE — attest: sha256:abcd...`
kevin: testing plan: run this flow in staging (dedicated airgapped lab) for two weeks, exercise rollbacks, simulate compromised operator key and ensure promotion rejects.
maria: agreed. I'll update RFC doc with the CLI samples, attestation payload spec, TTL defaults, canary hold defaults, and emergency rollback playbook. please add inline comments on the doc: https://redwood-internal.example/airgap/rehearsal-attest-rfc (draft).
tara: i'll add the attestation schema and nonce rules.
oliver: i'll draft the monitors and the auto-rollback thresholds and runbook steps.
maria: thanks all — if no objections i'll merge the RFC tomorrow and open a follow-up eng task to implement `redwoodctl --rehearse` and the attestation verifier library. :thumbsup:
kevin: :+1:
ops-bot: Note: this thread archived to RFC tracker #AG-214 after merge.
